name: flow_queue_caretakers_offered
description: The caretakers offered after 60 s queued (design 5.2): Find players waits for a member's Ready; alone, queued, at 1:00 NOTICE caretakers_offered ('Caretakers can fill the open seats'), the button becomes Start with caretakers with 'Cancel · 1:00' beside its line; it sends QUEUE start_with_caretakers and the party's match forms at once with three caretaker seats (MATCH_CONFIG's caretaker flag, 'Caretaker 1' to 3, Builders covering what a Lamplighter lacks), each 'gone' at the barrier and played by the simulation's caretaker from tick 0. It is the party's own match, not one of strangers: Play again brings the party back forming, not queued again (design 5.9's requeue is for a match the queue found).

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Find players' and node('Primary').disabled and node('PrimaryLine').text == 'Waiting for Ana'
steps.msg: the leader finds players once everyone is Ready

steps.assert: Session.last_notice == 'Caretakers can fill the open seats'
node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Start with caretakers' and not node('Primary').disabled
steps.msg: the one button starts with caretakers
the party's own match, out of the queue: Play again will not queue it again
three caretakers in the free seats

steps.assert: seats[1]['flags'] == 1 and seats[2]['flags'] == 1 and seats[3]['flags'] == 1 and seats[0]['flags'] == 0

steps.msg: Builders covering what a Lamplighter lacks: the Lookout, then the Bellfounder and the Beekeeper

steps.assert: Session.client.seat_list[1]['caretaker'] and Session.client.seat_list[3]['caretaker'] and not Session.client.seat_list[0]['caretaker']
steps.msg: the game seats them as caretakers
the simulation's caretaker plays their seats from tick 0
gone at the barrier: nobody to wait for
Play again after the caretakers: back to the party, forming, as after a Start
no QUEUE enter: a start with caretakers is not queued again
